name: North Ridge Residence
summary: A private residence with generous glazing, warm wood finishes and a sheltered garden terrace.
description: The residential concept brings daylight into the living spaces through floor-to-ceiling windows. Deep roof edges shade the terrace, while timber surfaces connect the house to its garden.

name: Prism Office Hub
alt: Office interior with shared tables and pendant lighting
summary: A shared workspace with generous tables, pendant lighting and an open industrial ceiling.
description: This office concept balances collaborative work with a calm material palette. Shared tables encourage conversation, while suspended lighting defines smaller working areas within the open room.

name: Kora Cultural Center
alt: Geometric facade and roof of a cultural centre
summary: A cultural venue defined by a sculptural roof, strong geometry and a generous public approach.
description: The cultural centre concept explores how a distinctive roof can give a public building its identity. A clear entrance and sheltered circulation connect gathering spaces, exhibitions and performance areas.

name: Echo Thermal Resort
alt: Outdoor spa pool surrounded by trees and lounge chairs
summary: An outdoor spa retreat where warm water, quiet terraces and woodland shape the experience.
description: The retreat concept places a thermal pool at the centre of a sheltered outdoor landscape. Seating areas and planted edges create places to pause, with views of the surrounding trees throughout the site.

name: Monolith Archive
alt: Curved white library shelves filled with books
summary: A bright library interior with continuous white bookshelves, soft curves and warm timber floors.
description: The library concept uses curved shelving to guide movement between collections and reading areas. White surfaces reflect daylight, while the timber floor brings warmth to a quiet public interior.

name: Glass Pavilion
alt: Garden pavilion with timber walls and large glazed openings
summary: A garden pavilion combining timber surfaces, large glazed openings and a connection to the landscape.
description: The pavilion concept links a flexible exhibition room with an outdoor garden. Large openings frame the planting, while warm wall finishes give the small building a domestic sense of scale.
